thread:
Olivia G: Quick sync — two launch blockers I want to call out: (1) licensing signoff for sable-13b-open and marlin-lite-7b, (2) missing perf profiles / embedding dim mismatch for marlin-lite. Can owners confirm status? cc @Maria C @Tom K @Sasha L
Maria C: Licensing update — I marked sable-13b as `apache-2.0` in the intake spreadsheet but legal asked for provenance on training data yesterday. Waiting on @Sasha L response. Marlin-lite is listed as MIT upstream; I can stage a manifest if legal gives thumbs up.
Tom K: Perf note — marlin-lite embeddings coming out as dim=1536 in our harness but catalog expects 1024. Quick sanity: looks like model has a projection layer. Not a quantization issue.
Ben R: I can generate a perf_profile once we freeze the artifact. If embedding dim=1536 we need to update catalog shape and downstream-embedding pipelines. Also recommend routing fallback to marlin-7b for services expecting 1024.
Sasha L: Legal triage — opened a request with upstream for sable training data provenance. If they confirm public datasets then apache-2.0 is fine. For marlin-lite MIT is OK but running contributor CLA check; will confirm by EOD.
Maria C: I'll hold manifest push for sable until Sasha confirms. For marlin-lite I can stage a manifest with `"pending-cla"` flag. Example snippet I'm preparing:
```
{
  "model": "marlin-lite-7b",
  "license": "MIT",
  "embedding_dim": 1536,
  "perf_profile": "pending"
}
```
Tom K: If @Ben R and I get the frozen artifact we can produce a perf_profile by ~18:00 PST today. If CLA is blocking manifest publish, we can still run perf locally and attach the profile to the staged manifest (status: pending legal).
Ben R: Starting perf run now: `./perf/run_profile.sh --model marlin-lite-7b --batch 8 --seq 256` — will paste results here when done.
curation-bot: ingest: marlin-lite-7b manifest staged at s3://catalog-temp/marlin-lite-7b/manifest.json (status: pending)
Olivia G: Thanks — launch gating needs perf_profile + manifest by tomorrow 12:00 PST. If we don't have sable cleared, propose excluding sable from initial catalog and ship marlin-lite (if CLA confirms). Agree? :thumbsup: 
Sasha L: Quick update — CLA check shows one outstanding contributor with unsigned CLA, upstream says they'll ping the contributor; ETA 15:00 PST. I'll post final status.
Maria C: If CLA fails we can mark marlin-lite `community-sourced` but legal prefers clean CLA for GA. Not ideal but ok for beta.
Olivia G: OK — plan: Ben/Tom run perf and attach profile, Maria stage manifest with pending flag. Sasha to confirm legal by EOD; if not, we'll remove sable and still aim for marlin-lite in beta. Thanks everyone!
Tom K: I'll upload perf_profile to S3 under `s3://perf-profiles/marlin-lite-7b/2026-03-17/` when done.
Ben R: Perf run done — summary: 12.3 ms/token @ batch8/seq256, embedding dim=1536. Uploading artifacts now.
curation-bot: perf: s3://perf-profiles/marlin-lite-7b/2026-03-17/profile.json (status: uploaded)
Olivia G: Perfect. Once Sasha posts final legal note I'll update the launch checklist and notify product. Appreciate the quick turn. :rocket:
